contract_ref: E001 tracked, committed snapshot; F005 external synchronization; AGENTS §6/8
claim: External synchronization does not invalidate the committed editor snapshot, so a snapshot-dependent binding evaluated earlier in the same batch remains permanently stale.

reproducer.setup: Mount TextInput(source="abc",controller:c) and Text({=>c.snapshot().text + "@" + caret}) guarded by c.isValid(); render once.
actions: Read the committed controller snapshot and render the same application again.
reproducer.expected: Both controller and dependent Text show Z@1 after stabilization.
reproducer.observed: Controller is Z@1, while the getter and rendered label remain abc@2. select() queues the snapshot binding via signal before the source binding; the getter reads the new source version but old local state. sync() then publishes Z@1 without notifying signal, so it is not revisited.

required_change: Publish/invalidate committed editor state in a safe phase so dependent bindings cannot miss synchronization. Preserve snapshot purity and do not fix this by pumping inside snapshot().

contract_ref: E003: horizontal movement/editing resets preferred display column; E002 undo/redo restores selection
claim: Undo/redo publishes a new text and caret but leaves preferredColumn from a previous vertical move, so subsequent vertical navigation uses the wrong column.

reproducer.setup: TextArea("ab\n12345\nXY"); select gap1, insert !, select gap8 (column4 on line2), then Down (clamped to column2 on line3, preferred4).
actions: Undo restores original text and gap1 (column1).
reproducer.expected: Down lands at gap4, column1 on line2.
reproducer.observed: Undo restores gap1, but Down lands at gap7, column4. history() never clears preferredColumn; ordinary replace() does.

required_change: Reset the preferred display column for successful undo and redo, consistently with other editing operations, and cover navigation after both history directions.

proof.source: handle300–301 syncs once and captures expectedVersion. Text/paste and TextArea Enter carry it through keyboardInput304/316→replace297; deletion computes its range against the same local state and passes preparedVersion405. In replace151–153, prepared callers bypass the source-refresh branch154–165. No callback/pump/local synchronization runs between captured state and candidate calculation; permitted background writes alter only Observable. commit224 passes the captured version to the unchanged sole-lock conditional write.
proof.old_counterexample: After handle reads ax/v, a worker sets YZ/v+1. The fix still calculates the old deletion result x, but editingCommit(v,x) sees v+1 and returns None; commit then syncs latest YZ and emits the sole ConcurrentValueChanged. It cannot change expectedVersion to v+1 or commit Z as the old implementation did.
proof.rejection_and_noop: Keyboard control/multiline/byte prevalidation uses the same frozen local text/selection and rejection returns before candidate publication; replace does not resync to a larger value after size validation. Same-text prepared/guarded paths check actual source version before selection-only publication; a mismatch returns false (prepared path synchronizes the external value) without applying the old selection, no text write/history/onChange. Guarded controller replacements retain normal identity/revision/actual-source checks. No implicit retry is added.
proof.race_attribution: Only text_edit_session145 emits ConcurrentValueChanged, following editingCommit(expectedVersion,next)==None. Observable.cj lock/value/version/atomic snapshot and conditional helper are unchanged. Actual fix1-editing output has both original conflict and I04 selector conflict with zero edits, finalYZ and no history. These establish observed conflicts, not which internal pre-commit interval was hit.
proof.limitation: The specific early planning window is not forced by the public fixture. Closure of that source-proven original finding rests on the explicit version/data-flow proof above; no exact-window execution is claimed.

contract_ref: E001 atomic read/compute/conditional commit and no retry of old paste/deletion intent; E002 keyboard rejection must preserve session
claim: Keyboard preparation and replace() do not share one source snapshot: replace() can resynchronize to a newer source and successfully apply a deletion range computed from the old source.

reproducer.setup: Source="ax", caret=1, source version v; dispatch Backspace while a permitted background writer is active.
actions: While handle scans graphemes, background source.set("YZ") commits v+1.
handle computes deletion range [0,1] from old text/selection.
replace() observes v+1 and syncs to YZ, but keeps the old range; it computes Z and successfully commits against v+1.
reproducer.expected: A background write after the edit snapshot wins: retain YZ, reject the old deletion with one ConcurrentValueChanged, no onChange/history for it.
reproducer.observed: The reachable source interleaving deletes Y from the background value, commits Z and emits onChange without a conflict. The later CAS is against the refreshed token, so it cannot detect this conflict. This specific interleaving is source-proven, not claimed executed. The same split also permits keyboard size prevalidation on old text followed by an IllegalArgumentException after replace refreshes to a larger value.

required_change: Capture the operation source/selection token once before keyboard planning and carry it through validation, range calculation and conditional commit. Reject intervening versions rather than silently rebasing the old intent; keep legitimate pre-operation external synchronization.
